About.Name: Tamana Muhseny
About.AboutText:
Hi, I am Tamana Muhseny, Electrical Engineering student at Seattle Pacific University.

I am dedicated to building a career in Electrical Engineering field. I mainly enjoy practical and hands-on works.

I have enjoyed my classroom circuitry projects.Beyond the classroom, I have been member Falcon Racing: Baja club on campus.

By participating in this club I have learned team work and analyzing problems from different perspectives.
